thread:
emma_customer: Hey team — our Dedicated pool keeps throttling since ~09:10 UTC. Requests return 429 for tenant-id: tenant_42. Token: r-abc123. Any idea?

james_support: Sorry about that, Emma. Can you paste a request_id from one of the 429s?

emma_customer: request_id: req_20260317_001, sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"model":"redwood-dedicated-v1","tenant":"tenant_42","input":"hi"}'
```

mike_sre: Looking at control plane logs — routing service returned pool_id: shared-burst-1 for tenant_42 at 09:09:58, then token quota enforcer applied limit -> 429. That seems wrong; tenant_42 should be pinned to dedicated-pool-42.

sasha_eng: We rolled out routing-policy change 3h ago that added tier fallthrough order optimization. Could be a policy comparator bug. @deploy-bot can you show the diff?

deploy-bot: deploy #2024.3.17-1502: modified routing/priority_sorter.go — changed rule evaluation order. Diff: -compare by exact tenant first +compare by cost estimate first

sasha_eng: yep that's the change. Seems like comparator now prefers lower-cost pools causing a dedicated tenant to fall through to shared pool if dedicated pool reported transient capacity=0 in control plane.

mike_sre: Repro steps: hit controlplane/routing/evaluate with tenant=tenant_42 returns pool=shared-burst-1 when dedicated reported 'available=false' in status cache. Repro locally by flipping status cache.

james_support: Temporary mitigation: setting tenant pin override for tenant_42 to true on controlplane console -> routes correctly to dedicated-pool-42. Customer confirmed reduced 429s.

sasha_eng: We'll rollback the comparator change immediately and cut a hotfix to preserve exact-tenant precedence. Assigning to eng-routing-urgency. Ticket: ENG-5692.

mike_sre: Noted. Also adding alert for 'route-to-nonpinned-pool' spike. @lexi_oncall can you monitor?

lexi_oncall: I'll watch dashboards. Slack thread updates and postmortem to follow. :white_check_mark: 

emma_customer: Thanks, team. Appreciate the quick fix — please keep me posted on timeline for permanent fix.
